diagnostic.title: Application crashes and all unsaved data is lost when clicking Save
diagnostic.description: Clicking the save button causes an immediate crash; nothing is persisted and the session must be restarted

diagnostic.title: SQL injection vulnerability in login form
diagnostic.description: The login form does not sanitize input, allowing crafted queries to access unauthorized database records

diagnostic.title: Payment processing charges customers twice for a single transaction
diagnostic.description: Users report duplicate charges appearing on their card statement after a single checkout

diagnostic.title: Server crashes completely when more than 50 users log in simultaneously
diagnostic.description: Load testing shows a full server crash and downtime once concurrent logins exceed 50

diagnostic.title: Clicking save button crashes the app and wipes unsaved changes
diagnostic.description: Same crash-on-save behavior as reported elsewhere; all in-progress edits are lost

diagnostic.title: Checkout page freezes when applying a discount code
diagnostic.description: Clicking "Apply Promo Code" causes a 500 error and the browser tab becomes unresponsive

diagnostic.title: User passwords visible in plain text in browser network requests
diagnostic.description: Inspecting network traffic during login shows the password field unencrypted in the request payload

diagnostic.title: File upload fails for all files larger than 10MB with no error message
diagnostic.description: Large uploads silently fail; the UI shows a spinner indefinitely with no feedback to the user

diagnostic.title: Search results return incorrect data for about 30% of queries
diagnostic.description: A sample of 20 test queries showed 6 returning results unrelated to the search term

diagnostic.title: Discount code entry causes checkout to hang and become unresponsive
diagnostic.description: Applying a promo code at checkout freezes the page, matching other reports of checkout instability

diagnostic.title: Profile picture upload sometimes takes over 30 seconds to complete
diagnostic.description: Upload works but is unusually slow under normal network conditions, no data loss

diagnostic.title: Email notifications delayed by several hours during peak usage
diagnostic.description: Notification emails are eventually delivered but with a multi-hour lag during high-traffic periods

diagnostic.title: Dashboard chart labels overlap on tablet-sized screens
diagnostic.description: Chart legends visually overlap between 768px-1024px viewport widths; desktop and mobile are unaffected

diagnostic.title: Export to CSV produces a file with incorrect column headers
diagnostic.description: The exported file has data in the right order but header row labels are shifted by one column

diagnostic.title: Submit button color doesn't match the rest of the UI theme
diagnostic.description: Minor visual inconsistency; button is functional, just the wrong shade of blue

diagnostic.title: Typo in the settings page: "Recieve" should be "Receive"
diagnostic.description: Cosmetic spelling error in static text, no functional impact

diagnostic.title: Tooltip text is slightly misaligned on hover for the help icon
diagnostic.description: Tooltip appears a few pixels off from the icon it's attached to

diagnostic.title: Footer copyright year shows last year instead of current year
diagnostic.description: Static text bug, purely cosmetic, no functional impact
